messages:
sam: Heads-up — Sales flagged an enterprise customer (Acme Health) asking for a 'blended token rate' when they mix reserved capacity + hosted credits. They want a single line-item rate and a 30-day grace buffer before overage billing. Wants product team input on feasibility and timeline.

alex (support): Ticket #45213 attached. Usage last month: 420M tokens. Reserved commit: 300M/mo at $0.0009/token. Hosted credits burned for spikes at $0.0015/token. Customer asks for blended ~ $0.0010 across the full 420M and credit visibility in the console.

maria (product): Quick clarifying Qs — is this a commercial negotiation (one customer) or a product change we should bake into roadmap? Need ARR for impact, recurrence (monthly spikes?), and legal/billing constraints. Also: do they expect retroactive re-billing?

alex (support): They're enterprise, ARR ~ $240k/year. Spikes are roughly monthly around campaign windows. No ask for retroactive billing today, they want forward-looking predictability and a single invoice line for FP&A.

patrick (finance): If we build a blended billing product, we lose per-bucket margin visibility unless we surface decomposition in BI. Finance prefers negotiated credits or a buffer SKU to avoid revenue leakage. Alternatives: 1) commercial one-off blended rate, 2) buffer credits sold with commit that cover spikes at a lower overage rate, or 3) productized blended-metering. Need to model margin impact before prod rollout.

jordan (eng): From infra side: billing pipeline needs a new computed meter ("effective_token_rate"). We'll need mapping rules: whether to deduct from reserved pool first or apply credits first, and how to produce audit entries. UI needs: billing console shows allocation + blended rate. Rough estimate: 2 sprints backend + 1 sprint frontend for MVP. Need exact acceptance criteria.

maria (product): Proposed triage: mark as P2 for product backlog. I'll write a short PRD with three options: (A) commercial one-off, (B) productized blended billing + UI + audit, (C) buffer-credit SKU + auto-apply policy. Acceptance criteria for (B): 1) billing console shows effective_rate and decomposition, 2) accounting preserves commit vs hosted buckets in BI, 3) audit log for any automated conversions, 4) canary rollout to 1-2 customers with manual finance checks.

sam: :thumbsup: Sales wants an initial proposal by next Tue. I'll push ARR and procurement timeline.

pricing-bot: New ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRIC-987 — linked to customer ticket #45213.

maria (product): I'll own the PRD. @jordan pls add a scoped eng estimate, @patrick pls add margin guardrails. Aiming for EOD Thu for scoping doc.

alex (support): Customer is amenable to piloting option C (buffer SKU) if we can prototype quickly. Procurement target: May 1.

patrick (finance): If pilot moves forward, require temporary holdback rules or pre-pay buffer to prevent unexpected negative margin. Also require BI flagging for pilot so we can reverse if needed.

jordan (eng): Noted. I'll scope telemetry + a migration script to map existing hosted credit burns into the buffer model. Estimate: 3 devs, ~6 weeks to productionize with canary.

maria (product): Triage summary: owner=maria, priority=P2, next steps=PRD + scoping + legal + finance sign-off. Labeling: #pricing-packaging #customer-driven. Will update thread when PRD is ready.

sam: Thanks — I'll coordinate Sales comms and share customer's PO cadence.
